reserves.name: USD cash in safeguarded accounts at regulated partner banks

reserveReview.rationale: Fluid Finance states that the DUSD supply is backed only by proven USD cash in client-safeguarded partner-bank accounts and that the smart contract prevents minting above the verified treasury balance. No investment-asset slice is disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fluid Finance issuer disclosure of DUSD safeguarded cash backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer disclosure does not name the partner banks or publish account-level balances.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: USD cash in safeguarded accounts at regulated partner banks
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: USD bank cash is external reserve backing rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Fluid describes client-safeguarded, ring-fenced bank funds and cash-only backing but does not identify the banks, provider shares, account jurisdictions, or the governing safeguarding agreements.
